name: TheAudioDB
author: Chronicle Contributors
description: Music metadata from TheAudioDB: artist biographies and artwork (thumbs, logos, banners, clear art, cut-outs, fan art), album descriptions and artwork (CD art, 3D cases, back covers), scores, genres, moods and styles, and track details. Works with the free key; a premium key lifts the limits. A fourth source beside MusicBrainz, Last.fm and Deezer, and independent of them.
fixMatchHint: Enter a TheAudioDB id with its kind (artist:111239, album:2109615, track:32724180), a theaudiodb.com artist, album or track URL, or artist-mb:, album-mb: or track-mb: followed by a MusicBrainz artist id, release-group id or recording id.

background_tasks.description: Looks up TheAudioDB metadata for artists, albums and tracks that have not been enriched by TheAudioDB yet. Paced at the free key's limit, so a large library takes many hours the first time.
Re-fetches all TheAudioDB metadata to pick up new artwork and corrected text. Very slow on a large library.
